verdict.rationale: Decagon says technical teams keep control over guardrails, and AOPs let teams define agent behavior in natural language like SOPs. Its integrations 'handle escalations smoothly', and Duet-generated tests check whether agents follow policies, so you could plausibly write escalation rules for legal, cancellation and security topics. However, the evidence never describes a topic-level human-only designation or forced handoff. Watchtower only flags interactions after the fact rather than preventing responses. Missing for 10: an explicit human-only topic or forced-handoff configuration, a guarantee that the agent will not respond on blocked topics, detail on how escalation routing works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
